gpu_note: no NVIDIA driver (nvidia-smi not found): Cycles renders and bakes on the CPU

blockbench.how: file level: writes and reads .bbmodel (format 5.0), imports through Blender

mixamo.how: manual workflow: prepares the upload FBX and merges downloaded clips

photogrammetry.note: no CUDA GPU: Draft Meshing from the SfM point cloud (coarser)

image_to_3d.how: ForgeCraft generate with a reference image: TripoSR / Hunyuan3D → MeshCraft process_mesh
image_to_3d.reason: TripoSR: missing: code, torch, weights (huggingface.co/stabilityai/TripoSR unreachable and not cached) (scripts/install-3d.sh ai weights); Hunyuan3D: local needs hy3dgen + an NVIDIA GPU with ≥6 GB VRAM (≥16 GB with texture); no CUDA GPU here; remote HF Space needs gradio_client and network access to huggingface.co (unreachable); set FORGECRAFT_HUNYUAN_LICENSE=accepted after confirming the Tencent Hunyuan 3D Community License (not licensed in the EU, UK or South Korea)

meshcraft.mode: MeshCraft engine (templates, mesh processing, PBR bake, export profiles, validation)

mixamo.mode: MeshCraft mixamo_* (upload prep, bone-name clip merge with rest-pose checks)
mixamo.note: Mixamo has no public API; a person uploads and downloads at mixamo.com (free Adobe ID)

meshroom.note: no CUDA GPU: Draft Meshing from the SfM point cloud (coarser)

triposr.reason: missing: code, torch, weights (huggingface.co/stabilityai/TripoSR unreachable and not cached) (scripts/install-3d.sh ai weights)

hunyuan3d.reason: local needs hy3dgen + an NVIDIA GPU with ≥6 GB VRAM (≥16 GB with texture); no CUDA GPU here; remote HF Space needs gradio_client and network access to huggingface.co (unreachable); set FORGECRAFT_HUNYUAN_LICENSE=accepted after confirming the Tencent Hunyuan 3D Community License (not licensed in the EU, UK or South Korea)

blender.note: MeshCraft's bpy venv, shared by the whole department; EEVEE/Workbench need OpenGL, so headless work uses Cycles
